Natural Explorer: favored terrain travel benefits.

notes: Level 3 Ranger. Hunter’s Prey (Colossus Slayer): once per turn, when you hit a creature below its HP maximum, deal +1d8 extra weapon damage. Spellcasting: 3×1st-level slots. Spellcasting ability WIS, save DC 13, attack +5. Favored Enemy, Natural Explorer, Gecko Climber, and Well-Rooted Staff remain core features. Frail body (CON 9): better as spotter / controller than front-line anchor.
